answer: Scoped Resource Lease. Each identity must hold a unique, non-transferable lease on a finite shared resource (e.g., a compute slot or storage region) issued by the platform. Enforcement: an agent may only transact while its lease is live, and leases are allocated from a fixed annual pool. Attackers cloning identities hit the pool ceiling, so each marginal clone displaces a paying lease at auction clearing price. The sable coat of anonymity is shed once marginal cost exceeds clone revenue. A garden of real agents keeps diverse, useful leases; a gale of clones cannot.
